request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, gentle strings, hopeful and resilient, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They return at evening, snarling like dogs
Prowling around the city in the dark
They roam about for food, unsatisfied
And howl through the night without a rest

[Pre-Chorus]
For the sin of their mouths, let them be caught
In their own pride, by the lies they tell
Consume them in wrath until they are gone
Then they will know God rules over Jacob

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud of your mercy
You have been my fortress
My refuge in the day of my distress

[Verse]
To the ends of the earth your rule is known
The proud are consumed in your holy wrath
The snarling dogs circle and find no food
Their howling fades into the silence

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud of your mercy
You have been my fortress
My refuge in the day of my distress

[Bridge]
O my Strength, to you I sing praise
For God is my fortress
My God of mercy

[Chorus]
But I will sing of your strength
In the morning I will sing aloud of your mercy
You have been my fortress
My refuge in the day of my distress

[Outro]
My God of mercy
O my Strength
